figs.name: temperature-sensor-response-time-thermowell-diagram
figs.alt: thermowell cross section showing heat path through wall, air gap and sheath to the sensor
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing heat passing from the process fluid through the thermowell wall, air gap and sheath, which raises RTD t90 from 9.5 s to about 40 s.
figs.after_h2: Real Response Times: Sensor to Thermowell

figs.name: temperature-sensor-response-time-plunge-lcsr-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart comparing plunge test and LCSR loop current step response testing of RTD sensors
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the plunge test done in a lab with the in service LCSR method that self heats the RTD element to measure installed response time.
figs.after_h2: Plunge Test vs LCSR: How Response Time Is Actually Measured
